papers.title: Processability of different IN738LC powder batches by selective laser melting

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究IN738LC镍基高温合金粉末的选区激光熔化工艺性，与生物医用增材制造方向完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on high-temperature superalloy processability for turbine applications, with no biomedical context, no porous structure design, no stress shielding analysis, no mechanical fatigue testing for implants, and no surface roughness or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究不同粉末批次对选区激光熔化工艺性的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用多种表征手段分析粉末特性与SLM成型质量的关系。
summary_zh.result: 粉末批次差异显著影响致密度和微观组织结构。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量密度和显微组织验证工艺性差异。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of powder batch variations on the selective laser melting processability of IN738LC superalloy.
summary_en.method: Multiple characterization techniques were employed to analyze powder properties and their correlation with SLM build quality.
summary_en.result: Powder batch variations significantly affect the density and microstructure of the fabricated parts.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurements of density and microstructural analysis were used to validate processability differences.

papers.title: No association between pseudotumors, high serum metal-ion levels and metal hypersensitivity in large-head metal-on-metal total hip arthroplasty at 5–7-year follow-up

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注金属对金属全髋关节置换术后的假瘤、血清金属离子水平与金属超敏反应，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或生物力学分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain, micromotion, or implant-bone interface mechanics; it is a clinical study on adverse reactions to metal debris without any biomechanical modeling or FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究大直径金属对金属全髋置换术后假瘤、金属离子水平与金属超敏反应的关系。
summary_zh.method: 对44例患者进行临床、影像和血清学评估及皮肤斑贴试验。
summary_zh.result: 假瘤与高金属离子水平或金属超敏反应无显著关联。
summary_zh.validation: 临床随访与影像学检查。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the association between pseudotumors, serum metal-ion levels, and metal hypersensitivity in patients with large-head metal-on-metal total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Clinical, radiographic, and serological evaluations along with skin patch testing were performed on 44 patients at 5–7 years follow-up.
summary_en.result: No significant association was found between pseudotumors and elevated metal-ion levels or metal hypersensitivity.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up with imaging and laboratory tests.
